unit.title: Rust Dependency Planner: Ownership, Errors, and Deterministic Tests
prerequisites: Fluency in at least one programming language
Familiarity with directed graphs and topological sorting
unit.scope: Implement and explain one small standard-library-only Rust library and CLI. The familiar graph algorithm is a vehicle for practicing API contracts, ownership, typed errors, deterministic behavior, tests, and tool-driven quality checks.

evidence_required: learner source and declared project files
captured formatter, build, test, and linter results
